race.comment: SO SI GOD (6) led and won last time out over 1200m at Belmont in a strong performance, running away to win by 1.8L. Out to 1400m now where she's been solid and she has the speed to work across from the tricky barrier. Still has plenty of upside and can continue her winning ways. BILLIONAIRE'S ROW (4) returned with an impressive victory over 1400m at Northam, running away to win by 3.6L. He's a progressive type on the way through and while he has drawn wide, he has the speed to roll across. Can continue to work through the grades. VAMPI QUEEN (13) has stormed over the top to score at her past couple, bringing up back-to-back wins, scoring by 2.2L last time out. Wide draw is no issue with her racing pattern and she can bring up the hat-trick. OCEAN GODDESS (8) won well fresh before finishing behind VAMPI QUEEN last time out. That form looks strong for this event. MIND FIELD (7) gets the blinkers on for the first time today and rates highly on his recent form. Can feature.
